description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractEngine' for a service engine in the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages service location mappings, dispatcher retrieval, and callback handling for services.

classes.name: AbstractEngine
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the core functionalities of a service engine, including service location resolution and callback dispatching.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the ServiceDispatcher instance associated with this engine.

methods.name: createLocationMap
methods.description: Creates an immutable map of service location aliases from configuration.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the actual service implementation location, considering aliases.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Overloaded methods to send callback events to registered listeners, with optional Throwable or result map.

methods.name: allowCallbacks
methods.description: Determines whether callbacks are permitted; currently always returns true.
